Scoped to its own // <svg> so several graphs can share an HTML page. It goes in a CDATA // section, so it must never contain the three characters that end one. // // Frames are <g class="f"> with data-x, data-w (samples), data-d (depth) // and, in a diff, data-a and data-b (samples before and after). A frame's // samples are the range [x, x + w): a frame's range holds its callees'. var S = document.currentScript, R = (S && S.closest && S.closest('svg')) || document.documentElement; var FRAMES = Array.prototype.slice.call(R.querySelectorAll('g.f')); FRAMES.forEach(function (g) { g.dataset.ox = g.dataset.x; g.dataset.ow = g.dataset.w; g.dataset.fill = g.querySelector('rect').getAttribute('fill'); }); var BOTTOM = FRAMES.filter(function (g) { return +g.dataset.d == 0; })[0]; var MATCH = null; // the active filter, a RegExp
function name(g) { return g.querySelector('title').textContent.replace(/ \((?:[0-9]+ samples|before ).*$/, ''); } function info(g) { R.querySelector('.fg-info').textContent = g.querySelector('title').textContent; } function h(s) { return String(s).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>'); } function pct(n) { return (100 * n / TOTAL).toFixed(1) + '%'; } function link(loc) { var m = loc.match(/^(.*):([0-9]+)$/), base = null, p; if (!m) return h(loc); if (/^src\//.test(m[1]) && SRC) { base = SRC; p = m[1]; } else if (/^crystal\//.test(m[1]) && CRYSTAL) { base = CRYSTAL + '/src'; p = m[1].slice(8); } return base ? '<a target="_blank" href="' + h(base + '/' + p + '#L' + m[2]) + '">' + h(loc) + '</a>' : h(loc); }
function show(g) { var n = name(g), w = +g.dataset.ow, el = R.querySelector('.fg-details'); if (+g.dataset.d == 0 && MATCH) { summary(); return; } if (DIFF) { var a = +g.dataset.a, b = +g.dataset.b, p1 = 100 * a / T1, p2 = 100 * b / T2, dd = p2 - p1; el.innerHTML = '<b>' + h(n) + '</b><br/>Before: ' + a + ' of ' + T1 + ' samples (' + p1.toFixed(1) + '%)<br/>After: ' + b + ' of ' + T2 + ' samples (' + p2.toFixed(1) + '%)<br/>Change: <b style="color:' + (dd >= 0 ? '#c23b2b' : '#3561c2') + '">' + (dd >= 0 ? '+' : '') + dd.toFixed(1) + ' percentage points</b>' + (a == 0 ? ' (only after)' : b == 0 ? ' (only before)' : '') + '<br/><span style="color:#777">Shares are of all samples of each profile. Source lines are in the before and after flame graphs.</span>'; return; } if (+g.dataset.d == 0) { el.innerHTML = 'All ' + TOTAL + ' samples. Click a frame for its source lines and sample counts.'; return; } var d = D[n] || [0, 0, []], s = '<b>' + h(n) + '</b><br/>This frame: ' + w + ' samples (' + pct(w) + '). In the whole profile: on the stack in ' + d[1] + ' samples (' + pct(d[1]) + '), running itself (top of stack) in ' + d[0] + ' (' + pct(d[0]) + ').<br/>'; if (d[2].length) { s += 'Lines in this function the samples were at (a call is the line of the call):<table style="border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:4px">'; d[2].forEach(function (r) { s += '<tr><td style="text-align:right;padding-right:10px">' + r[2] + '</td><td style="padding-right:10px">' + link(r[0]) + '</td><td style="color:#777">' + (r[1] ? 'inlined ' + h(r[1]) : '') + '</td></tr>'; }); s += '</table>'; } else s += '<span style="color:#777">No source lines: kernel, libc or libgc frame, a label, or no llvm-symbolizer/addr2line where the profile was taken.</span>'; el.innerHTML = s; }

PAD : PAD + (x - zx) * s, pw = parent ? W - 2 * PAD : w * s; r.setAttribute('x', px); r.setAttribute('width', pw); t.setAttribute('x', px + 3); var m = Math.floor((pw - 6) / CW); t.textContent = m < 3 ?
